pending.oldValue: Once a year, the [[ram-mandir-thakurbari|Ram Mandir Thakurbari]] hosts a Ram Katha — a multi-day public recitation of the Ramcharitmanas by a trained narrator. The 2021 edition was attended by the entire village, and was held under a pink-and-white striped pandal in the temple courtyard. The Katha is one of the most important religious events in the village calendar, reflecting the deep Vaishnavite tradition of the Mithila region.
